checks.method: Inspected both F29 drivers, verified composite child-summary hashes and driver hash, checked 114 receipts, and scanned approved source import syntax.
checks.observation: The driver rejects existing output, replaces LEAN_PATH with fresh base-build plus pinned package paths, and passes that fresh base explicitly to the child. Each module aborts on nonzero exit or unstable source; child failure propagates through check=True. All 114 receipts report stable successful compilation. Actual imports use the single-module syntax handled by the closure parser. The final audit validates expected roots and allowed axioms. These checks support removal of retained A1K objects, while leaving Lean/mathlib/package cache authenticity and independent reproduction outside scope.
